info.name: Cbez API Collection (v3.1 - Fully Updated)
info.description:
# Cbez B2C Platform - Complete Postman API Collection (v3.1)

Comprehensive, production-ready Postman collection covering all 71 API endpoints across 14 backend modules:
1. **Health Check** - API root & status
2. **Auth** - Customer registration, seller registration (optimized required fields: name, shopName, phone, email, address, password), login, and profile
3. **Users** - Full user management (including latitude/longitude and nested shop details)
4. **Shops** - Complete shop profiles (including coordinates, 13-field profile completion metrics, and live subscription usage)
5. **Products** - Multi-filter product search, seller listings, specsJson, conditionJson, and complete shop relations
6. **Categories** - Hierarchy & technical specifications templates
7. **Brands** - Brand catalog management
8. **Subscriptions** - Subscription plans, active plans, admin assignment, seller /mine status, and shop usage
9. **Leads** - WhatsApp & Phone Call lead generation
10. **Follows** - Shop follow/unfollow lifecycle & seller followers
11. **Location** - Forward geocoding, reverse geocoding, and GPS radius shop discovery
12. **Network** - B2B & Merchant trade inquiry boards
13. **Wishlist** - Toggle, add, remove, get list, and fast IDs
14. **Activity Logs** - Comprehensive event logging (LOCATION_CLICK, DIRECTIONS_CLICK, WHATSAPP_CLICK, CALL_CLICK, PRODUCT_CLICK, SHOP_CLICK, WISHLIST, and more)

### Authentication
Login or Register requests automatically save the JWT token to the collection variable `{{auth_token}}`. All protected endpoints automatically inherit or include this bearer token.

request.description:
Register a new seller merchant account.

Mandatory Required Fields:
- `name` (or `ownerName`): Owner Full Name
- `shopName`: Merchant Shop Business Name
- `phone`: Contact Phone Number
- `email`: Merchant Email Address
- `address`: Shop Business Address
- `password`: Account Password (min 6 characters)
- `role`: "seller"

All Other Details (Optional - May or may not be filled):
- `whatsapp` (defaults to phone)
- `city` (defaults to address/city)
- `district` (defaults to "Ernakulam")
- `country` (defaults to "India")
- `category` (defaults to "Mobiles & Tablets")
- `aadhaarNumber`
- `panNumber`
- `profileImage`
- `subscriptionPlanId`
- `latitude` & `longitude`
- `gstNumber`
- `websiteUrl`
- `businessHours`
- `businessDescription`
- `alternatePhone`

Logs customer and buyer actions across the platform.

Supported Actions:
- `LOCATION_CLICK` - Customer clicked Location / Google Maps button for a shop/product
- `DIRECTIONS_CLICK` - Customer requested directions to the physical store
- `WHATSAPP_CLICK` - Customer clicked to chat on WhatsApp
- `CALL_CLICK` - Customer clicked to call seller
- `PRODUCT_CLICK` - Customer viewed product details
- `SHOP_CLICK` - Customer viewed merchant shop profile
- `WISHLIST` - Customer added item to wishlist
- `WISHLIST_REMOVE` - Customer removed item from wishlist
- `CREATE_PRODUCT` / `UPDATE_PRODUCT` / `DELETE_PRODUCT`
- `CREATE_SHOP` / `UPDATE_SHOP`
- `REGISTER` / `LOGIN`

request.description: Fetches aggregated customer activity logs & high-intent leads for the authenticated seller's store and products (WhatsApp clicks, Phone calls, Store direction clicks, Wishlist adds, and Product views/clicks). For Premium Plan sellers, customer identities and contact details for product clicks/views are fully unlocked. For Free/Starter sellers, high-intent leads (calls/WhatsApp/directions/wishlist) are shown with customer details, while click/view customer details are masked with an upgrade notice.
